alias: Purifier — run after the cat toilet
description: v5. Runs the corridor purifier after a cat visit for up to ~28 minutes. The PM2.5 sensor is currently ASSUMED BROKEN (input_boolean.purifier_pm25_trusted is off), so it gets no vote and every run goes the full window; turning that toggle on restores the early stop, which additionally requires the reading to have risen after the visit before 'back down' means anything. The start is confirmed by WAITING for the fan to report on, never by reading its state at a guessed offset. If the start cannot be confirmed the fan is commanded off rather than abandoned.

actions.note:
v5. The operator has declared the PM2.5 sensor broken for now, after it failed to move across 46 minutes of full airflow immediately following a cat visit (see the design doc, incident 7.2).

THE ASSUMPTION IS A TOGGLE, NOT A REWRITE. input_boolean.purifier_pm25_trusted is off, and pm_usable requires it before the reading is allowed any influence at all. Cleaning the laser intake later is one switch, not a code change - and nothing about the automation's shape records a guess about the hardware that a future reader would have to reverse-engineer.

WITH IT OFF, EVERY RUN GOES THE FULL WINDOW. That is the same behaviour an unresponsive-but-trusted sensor already produced, so the change is small; what it buys is honesty. The old logic happened to do the right thing because the reading never rose. Now it does the right thing because we decided it should.

THE SETTLE AND THE READ ARE STILL DONE. They serve no control purpose while the sensor is untrusted, and that is deliberate: the run log records pm before, after settle and final on every cycle, so if the sensor ever starts moving again the line says '(untrusted - MOVED, worth rechecking)'. Deleting the read would make recovery invisible and would mean the toggle could never be flipped back on evidence.

EVERYTHING ELSE IS UNCHANGED from v4: the start is confirmed by waiting for the fan to report on and hold it 15 s rather than sampling at a guessed offset; an unconfirmed start commands the fan off rather than abandoning it; already_running refuses a fan somebody else started and says so; recovery fires on reload as well as restart; a manual stop suppresses re-starts for 30 minutes.
